content.purpose: Duplicate a file while keeping the original in place.
content.mentalModel: cp reads bytes from a source and writes a separate destination object. Later changes to one copy do not affect the other.

demonstration.explanation: This small example isolates the main idea behind copying files with cp.

remember: cp reads bytes from a source and writes a separate destination object. Later changes to one copy do not affect the other.

tasks.instruction: Copy /home/student/lab/source.conf to /home/student/lab/backup.conf without changing or removing the source.
hints: The original must still exist afterwards.
